sophia: Heads-up: offboarding next Friday and the engineer is asking about rolling their 401k to an IRA and electing HSA COBRA. Can we list exactly what forms we need and what evidence is acceptable?

mike: For 401k -> external IRA we need the employee-signed distribution/rollover election (direct rollover checkbox), plus either an IRA acceptance letter or a recent account statement showing the IRA account number and custodian. If they mistakenly got a cash distribution instead, that's an indirect rollover and different tax implications.

elaine: HSA COBRA requires the signed COBRA election form (they must elect within the 60-day window after qualifying event) and confirmation of payment method for post-termination coverage (we collect ACH or card). Vendor also needs the enrollment form so they can set an effective COBRA start date. We should also capture the date of last employer HSA contribution to compute any prorated employer match.

jack: Quick Qs: 1) Is an emailed screenshot of the IRA portal OK as "proof"? 2) Does the vendor need an original wet signature or is an e-sign OK for our forms?

mike: 1) Screenshot ok only if it's a PDF/printout with name, partial acct #, custodian and a timestamp; prefer official stmt/email. 2) E-signatures from the employee are fine if they come through our DocuSign/HelloSign flows; vendor acceptance depends on their policy but most accept e-signed elections.

elaine: I'll add a short checklist for the offboard packet. Also note: ask payroll to flag final payroll with "last pay" code so they can reconcile pre-tax HSA contributions before separation.

elaine: ```
Offboard benefits checklist (401k + HSA):
- Employee-signed 401k distribution/rollover election (direct rollover preferred)
- Proof of receiving IRA account (PDF stmt or acceptance email; screenshot acceptable if labeled and dated)
- If cash distribution received: note date and amount (indirect rollover window = 60 days)
- Signed HSA COBRA election form (completed within 60 days)
- Payment method for HSA COBRA (ACH or card)
- Vendor confirmations to file: rollover processing status, COBRA enrollment effective date, breakdown of last employer HSA contributions and dates
- Payroll flag for final run showing contribution buckets (pre-tax/post-tax)
```

sophia: Another edge case: employee got a small distribution check already and wants to deposit it to an IRA within 60 days. Can benefits/payroll help?

mike: If they cashed the check (made payable to them), it's an indirect rollover. Payroll cannot reclassify withholding; the employee has the 60-day rollover window and may need to file for refund of withheld taxes. We can provide guidance and the vendor contact but can't reverse withholding. If check is uncashed and still payable to the plan, vendor might be able to reissue as trustee-to-trustee; ask vendor immediately.

jack: I'll pause any final bonus sends until we confirm whether the distribution was processed to avoid mixing accounting entries.
